message.heavenly_realm.arrival: §bYou have left the mortal world. Find 7 Skybells and give them to the guardian angel to return.
message.heavenly_realm.returned: §6The angel accepted the flowers and returned you to the world of the living.
message.heavenly_realm.no_escape: §cDeath cannot free you from heaven. Complete the angel's request.
message.heavenly_realm.no_death: §bYou cannot die in Heaven. The angel returned you to the altar.
message.heavenly_realm.portal_blocked: §cThe gates will not release you. Helping the angel is the only way home.
message.heavenly_realm.void_saved: §bThe heavens caught you and returned you to the altar.
message.heavenly_realm.quest_ready: §aAll flowers collected! Return to the guardian angel.
message.heavenly_realm.missing_dimension: §cThe heavenly dimension could not be loaded. Check the mod installation.
